The precipitates in M0(Ni – Al) alloy have a cuboidal or a rectangular morphology, and the channel width of the matrix phase exceeds 100 nm, while precipitates in M2(Ni – Al – Re), M7(Ni – Al – W), and M8(Ni – Al – Ta) only exhibit a cuboidal morphology within 50 nm of the channel width in the matrix phase.
